protocol.data_access: No physical gauge links, sealed data, GPU, or QUDA data accessed.
protocol.heldout_use: evaluation-only; never used to fit pooled prior or online SLSQP
protocol.target_family: local_environment polynomial teacher with task-level coefficient variation
protocol.parameterization: joint trainable-W width-2; seven real parameters in [-3,3]
protocol.online_solver: SLSQP with analytic gradient, same class and box for every arm
protocol.strong_baseline: degree-4 Chebyshev in uniform hopping H, fit per evaluation panel
protocol.target_matched_control: fixed degree-2 local polynomial operator basis, fit per evaluation panel
protocol.tolerance_warning: Panel-specific shared training-fit contraction thresholds only; not D06 physical r_star or heldout selection rules.

objective_call_accounting.panel_equivalent_total_cost: (optimizer calls + one initial diagnostic evaluation) * training_panels
objective_call_accounting.prior_inference: copy seven frozen parameters; counted per evaluation task, no objective calls
objective_call_accounting.optimizer_and_baseline_fit_walltime: reported separately; synthetic input/target generation is excluded and not timed

limitations: synthetic task distribution and shared teacher family only
no physical reference or D06 effect threshold
degree-4 spectral comparator is a different operator family
small panel counts do not support population inference
